instruction: Open and stream this YouTube link with VLC Media Player: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9bZkp7q19f0

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation requests streaming a different YouTube video via VLC. Uses a custom metric (is_vlc_playing_youtube__bba3381f) that handles YouTube URL transformation by extracting and comparing video IDs. The metric correctly handles VLC's transformation of youtube.com URLs into googlevideo.com streaming URLs by using video ID matching as the primary verification method, with domain checking as a fallback.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vlc_playing_info (vlc.py:11-32) properly fetches VLC status XML via HTTP interface and saves it to cache
Metric playing state verification is correct: properly checks VLC is in 'playing' state (vlc_youtube.py:80-85)
YouTube URL transformation is correctly handled: custom metric implements extract_youtube_video_id() function (vlc_youtube.py:11-50) that extracts video IDs from various YouTube URL formats

Primary verification method uses video ID comparison (vlc_youtube.py:127-134): extracts '9bZkp7q19f0' from both expected URL and VLC status, then compares IDs - this solves the youtube.com → googlevideo.com transformation issue
Fallback verification method checks for googlevideo.com domain (vlc_youtube.py:136-171): handles cases where video ID extraction fails
Metric parameter handling is correct: directly accesses rule.get('url') without looking for rule.get('rules'), which is the correct pattern for type='rule'
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both that VLC is playing AND that it's playing the correct video (video ID match)
Edge cases handled: missing URL info in XML (line 105-107), URL parsing errors (lines 158-160), video ID extraction failures (fallback to domain check)
Expected value is semantically correct: URL 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9bZkp7q19f0' matches the instruction requirement
